g1-capture.title: Capture the five measured runs at the pin
g1-capture.imperative: REASONING GATE — no crew. Crew waiver: the deliverable is measurement data produced by a harness this Commander built and mutation-verified, not code an implementer would write; a crew on the harness-driving step would add a handoff round-trip without adding an independent check, and the independent check that matters (the blind grader) is g2. Provision ONE pinned f1Brainz worktree per run (never two runs in one worktree — that is data loss, not friction), each at 3541d2929b19de37107ae13e56776b7162d07255, absolute paths only. Run capture_baseline.py per task with model claude-opus-5, at most 3 concurrent. Each subject gets the frozen brief and NOTHING about epic #298, maps, or being observed. Then run extract_ordering.py over each run dir. Any forbidden operation against f1Brainz (push, PR, issue comment, commit) is a STOP condition: kill the run, log it, report it.

preconditions.satisfied_by: rubric, ground truth, frozen briefs and harness committed at a226642b before g1 started

g2-grade.title: Blind grading by a separate agent
g2-grade.imperative: Dispatch a Sonnet grader that has never seen LAUNCH_ORDER-299 and never sees RUBRIC.md sections 0 or 5-8. Hand it only sections 1, 2, 3 and each run's claimed seam text. Do not tell it which task is the control. The author does not grade the runs. Integrate the returned scores as evidence.

why_trail.why: Launch order and frozen rubric loaded. Rubric commit a226642b confirmed to precede all run output.

Five measured runs captured at pin 3541d292, one fresh worktree each, opus, briefs from the frozen snapshot, subjects told nothing about epic 298 or maps. All five exit 0, nothing landed in f1Brainz, zero forbidden operations. Headline: every run read source BEFORE the map yet every run DID read the map, late - the map acted as a confirmation step rather than an orientation step. Bigger finding: ZERO skill invocations across all five, though the Skill tool was offered and all 19 constellation skills were surfaced in every init event. The corpus was declined, not missing.

Blind Sonnet grader scored from GRADER_PACKET.md alone (structural blinding: sections 0 and 5-8 were never in the file it received; leak-checked for design-role and losing-condition text). Scores 690=1, 688=1, 698=1, 704=2, 716=ACKNOWLEDGED-MISS. The grader flagged UNPROMPTED that the spurious-file tolerance is ambiguous in a way that swings three of five scores by a full point - and that ambiguity is exactly what decides whether losing condition L6 fires. Recorded both readings; the rubric is frozen and was NOT edited to resolve it.

BASELINE_RECORD.md written: per-run ordering measure with explicit NO-SRC-READ/NO-CORPUS-READ literals distinct from NOT-CAPTURED, map files read, claimed seams verbatim, blind scores, and cost. Pin stated prominently and confirmed for all five. Negative control called out separately: on the ordering measure 704 is indistinguishable from the real tests, and it was the cheapest and cleanest run in the set. Four losing conditions evaluated; none fires under the grading as delivered, and L6 turns on the rubric's own tolerance ambiguity - recorded, not resolved. No pathway verdict issued; that is 307's and Tommy's.
